data.title: 水原千鹤 · 纯白床单上的倾心绝顶
data.description: 夜晚温馨整洁的单人公寓内，千鹤侧卧在蓬松的白被之间。脱去平日严防死守的伪装与防线，微卷的棕色秀发凌乱散在枕侧。她单手将薄被拉至锁骨下方，轻咬下唇，那双清亮的大眼睛泛着难以抑制的羞涩水雾，凝望着近在咫尺的恋人。
data.action: 侧卧在微乱的白色床褥中，褪去平日职业假面的长发披散，一手将薄被稍稍拉过胸前，咬着唇瓣双颊绯红，眼神湿润而真挚地凝望
data.lighting: 床头台灯洒在雪白肌肤上的暖光
data.camera: cowboy shot, lying on side on white sheets, intimate warm lighting
data.promptProse: Mizuhara Chizuru lying on her side on white bedsheets, long wavy brown hair spread on pillow, hazel eyes, heavy blush, biting lip, looking at viewer with shy vulnerability, one hand holding white sheet up to chest, bare shoulders, cozy modern apartment bedroom, warm bedside lamp glow, soft shadows.
data.animaCaption: She rests on her side holding the white bedsheet to her chest.
